contract.note: A general application-cost trend including reasoning tokens is an ordinary reading of the passage. Requiring representative comparable workloads fairly distinguishes that trend from isolated examples.

evidence.note: Cursor reports mostly stable user costs and much higher costs for difficult requests. This company disclosure lacks representative longitudinal measurements of comparable completed work.
OpenAI reports lower median-query prices under typical token and cache assumptions. This company disclosure does not measure the general deployed-application cost trend.

reviews.rationale: Neither company example establishes rising or falling costs across representative comparable application workloads. The packet lacks the longitudinal usage, quality, and completed-work measurements required to settle the general trend.
